Cc: procurement@vitapulse.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing ask — immediate support required

Sean —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the internal ROI on Redwood’s Hosted API and are excited, but pricing is the main blocker for us to commit to the 12-month usage path. We expect an immediate ramp to ~40B tokens over the first 12 months; attached is a conservative forecast and our proposed commercial terms.

Quick context:
- We are evaluating two vendors side-by-side and need a commitment decision by 01/20 to align budget and vendor integration timelines.
- Primary ask: a one-time pricing concession that brings list consumption rates down by ~28% across text-generate endpoints for a 12-month committed spend (~$3.2M).
- We can agree to a 60% prepay or an accelerated onboarding milestone schedule if that eases risk.

Can you escalate for senior approval? The procurement team is on a tight deadline and has asked for an exec-level signoff for discounts beyond standard commercial bands.

Attachments: VitaPulse_MA_v1.2.pdf (SOW, security checklist), VP_usage_forecast_Q1-Q4_2028.xlsx

Appreciate any fast guidance — happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Maria Alvarez
Head of Data & Integrations
VitaPulse Inc.
[m]: +1 415-555-0133

Ben, Marissa — looping you both in for a rapid decision. VitaPulse is looking for ~28% off list consumption rates for a 12-month commitment (~$3.2M). They can prepay 60% or commit to onboarding milestones. Timeline: they need a commercial decision by 01/20.

Key commercial levers I recommend we consider:
- 12-month committed tier with 60% prepay (improves cashflow).
- Structured ramp credits if they miss initial throughput milestones.
- A termination clause if usage falls below 40% of forecast in months 4-6.

Impact: at 28% off list this is outside standard delegated discount bands and would meaningfully reduce unit margin. I think there is strategic upside: VitaPulse is a potential reference customer in cardiometabolic vertical with strong traction and PR channels.

Attachments: deal_summary_for_exec.pdf (summary of proposed economics and impact to unit margin).

Request: Can we get a senior authorization (VP or above) for up to 28% off list for Hosted API, conditional on 60% prepay and legal review? If not, what is the maximum you can approve so I can take that back to Maria today?

Thanks —

Sean / Marissa —

Quick analysis after the deal summary:
- At a $3.2M committed ARR and 28% off list, estimated blended unit margin drops below our threshold for strategic retained deals unless we secure the 60% prepay.
- Approving >25% without counter-mitigations (prepay, milestone SLAs, or shorter LOE for onboarding) exposes us to a non-trivial revenue-at-risk.

I can approve up to 24% off list at Director-level if the account takes:
- 60% prepay, and
- a soft-commit onboarding SLA (T+60 days to production) plus a ramp credit schedule for missed milestones.

If Marissa signs off for >25%, I recommend we:
- Require finite prepay (60%),
- Add a 6-month re-evaluation clause and overage repricing, and
- Push for a public case study + exec intro (marketing value).

Happy to discuss on quick call. This one is borderline but could be strategic.
